# Zennly

> Zennly is a booking and management platform for appointment-based service businesses in Nepal and worldwide — spas, wellness centers, salons, nail studios, tattoo and piercing studios, yoga studios, gyms, barbershops, clinics, physiotherapy and cleaning services — from a single location to many branches. It replaces phone-and-spreadsheet scheduling with online booking, staff/room scheduling, discount approval workflows, and daily payment reconciliation, unified across every branch.

Zennly is not a calendar widget or generic booking tool — it works for a single location and scales to multi-branch teams, with: staff transfers between branches, discount-request approval chains, role-based access for owners/managers/front-desk, and a locked daily financial close.

## Entity facts

- Name: Zennly (zennly.io). Also referred to as "Zennly booking software". Not related to zennly.org. Not the Zenly social map app (Snap): Zennly, spelled with two n's, is booking software for spas, salons, gyms and clinics in Nepal.
- Type: Web-based booking and business management software for service businesses in Nepal.
- Markets: built in Nepal. Available to service businesses in any country on request, including the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and the UAE.
- Based in: Lalitpur (Patan), Bagmati Province, Nepal, in the Kathmandu Valley (Kathmandu, Lalitpur and Bhaktapur). Serves service businesses across the whole Kathmandu Valley. Launched 2026. Built by Zunkiree Labs (https://zunkireelabs.com, founded 2018).
- Contact: info@zennly.io, +977-9747491787.
- First live client: Nuad Thai Spa Kathmandu, four branches, 39 therapists, 12 rooms, 194 services.
- Pricing: custom quote, no fixed tiers. Payments are recorded by method (cash, card, online).

## Product

- [Pricing](https://zennly.io/businesses/pricing): Custom quote based on branches, team size, and features used — no fixed tier list.
- [Booking](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/booking): Multi-branch appointment booking with database-level conflict prevention.
- [Operational visibility](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/operational-visibility): Real-time status across all branches in one dashboard.
- [Payment tracking](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/payment-tracking): Payment recorded at point of service, tied to the booking.
- [Reports](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/reports): Built-in revenue, staff performance, discount, attendance, and referral reports.
- [Staff management](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/staff-management): Temporary and permanent staff transfers between branches (a visiting therapist is locked at their home branch for the visit, opens for bookings again when the time is up, and the visit can be extended or ended early), a notification to the receiving branch, attendance records (in, out, absent) and therapist/room assignment.
- [Discount management](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/discount-management): Discount requests require manager approval with a full audit trail.
- [Role-based access](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/role-based-access): Three-tier permission model for owners, managers, and front desk.
- [Memberships](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/memberships): Prepaid customer membership tiers with wallet balance, validity dates, renewals and payment at checkout.
- [Packages](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/packages): Session bundles for one service, redeemed at checkout with remaining-session and amount-due tracking.
- [Vouchers](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/vouchers): Prepaid and gift vouchers with unique codes, partial claims and expiry.
- [Campaigns](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/campaigns): Dated percentage promotions on chosen services, shown in online booking.
- [Outreach](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/outreach): Win-back and review-request messages by email, with SMS and WhatsApp available on request, and an optional approval queue.
- [AI receptionist](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/ai-assistant): An AI assistant that answers customer calls and chats and helps them book, available on request.
- [Press kit and company facts](https://zennly.io/businesses/press): Official descriptions and facts for citing Zennly.
- [Payroll](https://zennly.io/businesses/features/payroll): Monthly per-branch payroll from salary, attendance and commission.
- Also in the product: campaigns and customer outreach, discount approvals, waiting list, live walk-in queue with estimated waits, class capacity limits and digital consent forms. See the blog guides below.
